info.title: Game Event Script CLI
info.description: Command-line entry point for Game Event Script.

commands.name: bench
commands.description: Measure the steady state of a compiled program in this process. Use 'dotnet ges bench --help' for options.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Message every run sends (default: Main); Main(args) receives an empty list.

options.name: --warmup
options.description: Untimed runs before measuring (default: 20).

options.name: --iterations
options.description: Timed runs (default: 50).

options.name: --min-time
options.description: Continue warming up until this many milliseconds have passed.

options.name: --fresh-instance
options.description: Create the Host and instance for every run; their creation is timed separately.

options.name: --gc-between
options.description: Collect garbage before every run, untimed.

options.name: --per-iteration
options.description: List every timed run.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print one JSON object instead of text.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Signed 64-bit random seed. Omit for a fresh host seed.

options.name: --max-messages
options.description: Maximum processed messages per pump (default: 64).

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: Maximum execution steps per handler (default: 100000).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Validate source files without writing a binary. Use 'dotnet ges check --help' for options.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include bindings, dependencies, bytecode size, and resource requirements.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress success output. Errors are still reported.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                  Treat remaining arguments as file names.
Sources are compiled and validated together without writing a binary or executing
handlers. Source order, UTF-8 decoding, and file-name patterns match 'dotnet ges compile'.
Checking does not resolve host extensions or external types against a runtime registry.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile UTF-8 source files together to .gesb. Use 'dotnet ges compile --help' for options.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file. Required for multiple sources; otherwise defaults to source.gesb.

options.name: --no-debug
options.description: Omit debug symbols, source map, and source archive.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include bindings, dependencies, bytecode size, and resource requirements.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress successful compilation output. Errors are still reported.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                  Treat remaining arguments as file names.
Sources are compiled together in argument order. File-name patterns such as
"scripts/*.ges" expand in ordinal order; directory wildcards and recursion are not supported.
Repeated paths are included once, keeping their first position.
Output directories are created as needed. Existing output is replaced after
successful compilation. Source files must be UTF-8, with an optional UTF-8 BOM.

commands.name: document
commands.description: Check or format GES documents (.gesd). Use 'dotnet ges document --help' for options.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the formatted document to a UTF-8 file instead of stdout.

options.name: --color
options.description: Color terminal output (unless NO_COLOR is set).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Hide the success report of check.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                   Treat remaining arguments as file names.
Reading follows the strict document rules: unquoted Text, duplicate keys and
invalid literals are errors. Formatting drops comments and layout; the output
reads back to an equal document. An existing output file is replaced only after
successful reading. The schema reference is kept, but schema files are not read.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Read GES documents and report the first error of each with its line and column.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the formatted document to a UTF-8 file instead of stdout.

options.name: --color

commands.name: format
commands.description: Print a GES document in the recommended layout.

commands.name: dump
commands.description: Dump a .gesb file as GESA text. Use 'dotnet ges dump --help' for options.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write to a UTF-8 file instead of stdout.

options.name: --addresses
options.description: Include zero-based instruction addresses.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
--                  Treat remaining arguments as file names.
The binary is validated before producing GESA text. Embedded debug information
is used when available; source files and host bindings are not required.
Output directories are created as needed. An existing output file is replaced
only after successful decoding and dump generation.
Terminal output uses four-column tab stops; files and redirected output retain tabs.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run Main(args), an event scenario, or the event console. Use 'dotnet ges run --help' for options.

options.name: --scenario
options.description: Run a separate scenario instead of Main. Repeat for combined sources.

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Open the event console instead of Main. Initial files are optional.

options.name: --arg
options.description: Append exactly one value, even if it looks like an option.

options.name: --args
options.description: Append values until the next option. Negative numbers are values.

options.name: --color
options.description: Enable ANSI colors and live input highlighting (unless NO_COLOR is set).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Trace emit, publish, and dispatch on stderr; yellow in colored interactive mode.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Hide completion/load/unload/reload reports; console output and errors remain visible.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Signed 64-bit random seed. Omit for a fresh host seed.

options.name: --max-messages
options.description: Maximum processed messages per pump/input (default: 64).

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: Maximum execution steps per handler (default: 100000).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Check, format or hash GES schemas (.gess), dump binary data, and generate code. Use 'dotnet ges schema --help' for options.

options.name: --root
options.description: The schema, message or message set; layout and generate accept several and a network.

options.name: --all-roots
options.description: Make every declaration of the files a root of layout or generate.

options.name: --wire
options.description: Make the wire roots of the group the roots, in declaration order; wire alone is the group default.

options.name: --model
options.description: Generate plain model types of the model roots of the group instead of wire code.

options.name: --language
options.description: The language that generate writes: csharp or swift.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of the generated types; Swift declares it as nested enums.

options.name: --access
options.description: The visibility of the generated types: public (default) or internal.

options.name: --values
options.description: Also convert generated records and models to and from GES values and messages.

options.name: --checked-exclusivity
options.description: Keep the dynamic exclusivity checks of generated Swift classes.

options.name: --extend-namespace
options.description:
Extend this leading part of the Swift namespace, which another generation of the module
declares, instead of declaring it; wire code with --models does so for the part it shares.

options.name: --schemas
options.description:
Declare the schema set type <Name>, which holds the embedded sources and parameter values
and binds conversions, networks and documents for this and other generations.

options.name: --use-schemas
options.description: Use the schema set type that another generation declares, instead of embedding the sources.

options.name: --import
options.description: Import this Swift module in every generated file, such as the module of --use-schemas.

options.name: --bindings
options.description: Also offer generated model types to scripts as external types; only with --model.

options.name: --documents
options.description: Also read model roots from GES document text; includes --values, only with --model.

options.name: --models
options.description:
Share the packed types of the model code in that namespace ("" for the global one) and
convert wire records directly to and from the models of their schemas; only wire code.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Write the code as several files into a directory that generate owns, with a manifest.

options.name: --split
options.description: With --out-dir, one file per declaration (schema, the default) or per schema file (file).

options.name: --check
options.description:
Compare the generated code with the output file or directory instead of writing it;
changed, missing and surplus files fail.

options.name: --param
options.description: A parameter value such as worldWidth=5000m; repeat for each one.

options.name: --data
options.description: The binary data of dump.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: The full record that makes dump read the data as a delta.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the formatted source, the layout or the code to a UTF-8 file instead of stdout.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Hide the success report of check.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.description: The schema, message or message set; layout and generate accept several and a network.

options.name: --all-roots
options.description: Make every declaration of the files a root of layout or generate.

options.name: --wire
options.description: Make the wire roots of the group the roots, in declaration order; wire alone is the group default.

options.name: --model
options.description: Generate plain model types of the model roots of the group instead of wire code.

options.name: --language
options.description: The language that generate writes: csharp or swift.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace of the generated types; Swift declares it as nested enums.

options.name: --access
options.description: The visibility of the generated types: public (default) or internal.

options.name: --values
options.description: Also convert generated records and models to and from GES values and messages.

options.name: --checked-exclusivity
options.description: Keep the dynamic exclusivity checks of generated Swift classes.

options.name: --extend-namespace
options.description:
Extend this leading part of the Swift namespace, which another generation of the module
declares, instead of declaring it; wire code with --models does so for the part it shares.

options.name: --schemas
options.description:
Declare the schema set type <Name>, which holds the embedded sources and parameter values
and binds conversions, networks and documents for this and other generations.

options.name: --use-schemas
options.description: Use the schema set type that another generation declares, instead of embedding the sources.

options.name: --import
options.description: Import this Swift module in every generated file, such as the module of --use-schemas.

options.name: --bindings
options.description: Also offer generated model types to scripts as external types; only with --model.

options.name: --documents
options.description: Also read model roots from GES document text; includes --values, only with --model.

options.name: --models
options.description:
Share the packed types of the model code in that namespace ("" for the global one) and
convert wire records directly to and from the models of their schemas; only wire code.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Write the code as several files into a directory that generate owns, with a manifest.

options.name: --split
options.description: With --out-dir, one file per declaration (schema, the default) or per schema file (file).

options.name: --check
options.description:
Compare the generated code with the output file or directory instead of writing it;
changed, missing and surplus files fail.

options.name: --param
options.description: A parameter value such as worldWidth=5000m; repeat for each one.

options.name: --data
options.description: The binary data of dump.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: The full record that makes dump read the data as a delta.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the formatted source, the layout or the code to a UTF-8 file instead of stdout.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Hide the success report of check.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

commands.name: canonical
commands.description: Print the canonical form that the schema hash runs over.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Read schemas and report the first error with its line and column.

commands.name: dump
commands.description: List each field of binary data with its bit offset, width and value.

commands.name: format
commands.description: Print a schema source in the recommended layout. Comments are dropped.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate C# or Swift code that writes and reads the records of the roots and every type they reach.

commands.name: hash
commands.description: Print the schema hash and, with parameters, the binding hash.

commands.name: layout
commands.description: Print the language-neutral generation layout of the roots and every type they reach as JSON.
